# No-show deposit

A 25 % no-show deposit cut no-shows from 18 % to 4 % in six weeks. Delia tried it first, on new customers only, and the ones who paid the deposit almost never cancel late. The deposit is charged through Stripe Connect Express when the booking is made and credited against the final bill.

# SMS reminder timing

A reminder SMS two hours before the slot beats one the night before; the night-before one gets ignored. Groomers on the road read a text right before they pull into a driveway, and customers answer it with a thumbs-up or a reschedule request while there is still time to fill the slot.

Internal tag: canary-obsidian-02 (tidewell-seed).

# Calendar sync can wait

Do not build calendar sync before fifty customers; the first forty never asked for it. Marcus quoted three weeks for a two-way sync with the big calendar apps, and I would rather spend those weeks on the route optimiser that every groomer does ask about.

output.content:
Suds & Buds Mobile Grooming, owner Delia Farrow, is the first paying customer, since 2026-03-12. One van, about thirty bookings a week, mostly repeat customers in the north end of Port Alder. She reads every product update and answers within the hour, which is why she is the person I test things on first.

# <Onboarding> 🐕 checklist & "quotes"

Steps for a new groomer, in order, before their first booking goes live:

- [ ] Connect Stripe Connect Express and read the payout warning aloud.
- [ ] Add the van, the service area and the working hours.
- [ ] Import the customer list from a spreadsheet, or start empty.
- [ ] Send one test booking to a phone the groomer owns.
